ref: #48 owner decision Q4: case-insensitive is String.compareToIgnoreCase; #2 §4 sort: "within the existing or set context", stable, numeric or lexicographic (case-sensitive or not), ascending or descending [SAP✓ STD]
note: caseInsensitive over the input of fn/sort/001. compareToIgnoreCase compares toLowerCase(toUpperCase(c)), so _ (5F) comes before every letter, and the ties a, A and B, b stay in input order (a stable sort): 10, 9, _, a, A, B, b and e, f, Z, é. Lexicographic would give A, B, _, a, b. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
